title: Malicious code in @secauditb20y/sec-test-b1 (npm)
description: The npm package @secauditb20y/sec-test-b1 contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by it, as the attacker may have established persistent control.
